messages:
Harper N.: quick morning sync  marketplace listing readiness for EdgeCloud + SI integrator. Key gates: press embargo owner, localized hero & CTAs (EN/FR/DE), SI demo reproducibility, screenshots, and post-launch dashboard. target publish Thu Sep 5. who can own which?

Jin W.: I'll take embargo + partner comms. partner prefers Thu 23:59 PT embargo if legal clears. if not, fallback = Fri morning staggered release.

Rita P.: i'll own localized hero + CTA variants. drafting three hero lines and CTAs for EN/FR/DE by EOD. leaning concise technical tone.

Collins-bot: Staging tenant provisioned: rwd-edgecloud-locale-stg-0905. Creds sent to Jin W., Rita P., Marta L. Expires in 72h.

Marta L.: i'll manage SI demo and screenshots. need canonical prompt set and a minimal dataset (anonymized). also will record a 15m run for the docs site.

Harper N.: canonical prompts: `summarize_release`, `policy_check`, `semantic_search_examples`. adding them to the drive along with sample dataset template.

Rita P.: hero proposals: 1) "Redwood + EdgeCloud: inference at cloud scale" 2) "Run predictable LLM inference in your cloud" 3) "Private, fast LLM inference for enterprise workloads". CTAs EN: `Get started` / `Request demo`. FR: `Commencer` / `Demander une démo`. DE: `Loslegen` / `Demo anfordern`. thoughts?

Jin W.: option 2 + dev-friendly CTA for docs: `Quickstart`. partner asked to soften "private" phrasing in headline.

Marta L.: screenshot script example:

```
# screenshot run for recording
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-accelerate","input":"Summarize the new EdgeCloud marketplace offering in two sentences"}'
```

Harper N.: legal note: partner legal needs all co-branded assets by Tue 12:00 PT. Jin, can you confirm partner comms contact?

Jin W.: confirmed. i've added partner-legal@edgecloud.com to the dry-run invite.

Marta L.: dry-run times: Wed 17:00 PT or Thu 08:00 PT. Wed works better for SI core team. recommend Wed so we can iterate before Thurs publish.

Collins-bot: Calendar invite scheduled: EdgeCloud marketplace dry run on 2024-09-04T00:00:00Z (Wed 17:00 PT).

Rita P.: localization question: do we show localized CTAs only for EMEA locales or all pages? we should probably surface EN + locale selector on listing.

Harper N.: show locale selector and default to region view for EU visitors. Sales asked for a small perf table on listing (avg latency / 1k tokens). I'll pull numbers with infra tomorrow.

Marta L.: recording plan: capture screen + terminal output, blur API keys, store raw in restricted S3, export trimmed 2-min clips for listing carousel.

Jin W.: press embargo plan: hold until partner quote arrives by Tue COB. if quote misses, publish without quote and follow-up blog with partner case study in week 2.

Harper N.: owners recap -> Embargo & comms: Jin W.; Hero & localization: Rita P.; Demo + screenshots: Marta L.; Staging infra: Collins-bot; Legal & runbook: Harper N. shout if you need to swap.

Rita P.: uploading hero + CTA variants to drive now and tagging legal fields.

Marta L.: will post screenshot checklist to the runbook and pick up staging creds.

Jin W.: sending partner embargo email draft in 30m. will tag comms and legal for review.

Harper N.: perfect. i'll consolidate checklist and post final runbook after dry run. thanks all :rocket:
